target.outcome: Daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths
target.pollutant: NO2 STAP; PM2.5 target was attempted but not fit
target.period: Article target 2020-02-21 to 2020-05-19; retained complete overlap 2020-05-05 to 2020-05-19
target.exposure_assignment: Unweighted mean of monitor daily means within each administrative polygon
target.model: Log-link count models: AR(1) Poisson GEE for deaths; robust Poisson GLM fallback for cases after recorded GEE failure
covariates: None identifiable in bounded overlap; article lockdown is constant
target.named_outcome_source: Italian Civil Protection COVID-19 regional archive

sources.url: OpenAQ archive S3 and OpenAQ v3 via AERIS

substitutions.reason: Article-named legacy EEA export URL returned HTTP 404; OpenAQ yielded usable NO2 records.
AERIS OpenAQ retrieval covered 22.47% of target dates.
No PM2.5 records and no 8-year LTAP were recovered.
Lockdown is constant and meteorology was not recovered.

substitutions.reanalysis: case GLM fallback; death GEE AR(1)
substitutions.reason: Case AR(1) GEE convergence failure retained in native output.

coverage.rule: Retain deterministic complete date-region overlap with recovered AERIS NO2; no imputation.
coverage.notes: 30 region-days across 5–19 May; dates outside the article end date were excluded.

effects.label: NO2 STAP and daily cases, bounded model
NO2 STAP and daily deaths, bounded model

blockers: OpenAQ NO2 covered only 16 common dates across the two regions.
LTAP, meteorology, and variable lockdown could not be included.
Bounded panel has only two region clusters and is not a credible published-effect replication.
